profile_text.body:
Chegg is a publicly traded education technology company (ticker: CHGG) that has operated since 2003 and describes itself as offering innovative learning tools with 24/7 homework help across more than 50 subjects. Its site promotes step-by-step support, real experts, and high-quality solutions enhanced by student feedback, available through Chegg Study and Chegg Study Pack subscriptions.

The company's AI product is CheggMate, categorized as an Education and Research AI tool serving as a study assistant for academic help. The held facts note considerations around student data, content accuracy, and honor code implications in connection with the product. Chegg's site itself references an honor code policy alongside its general terms and privacy policy.

Chegg is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001364954 and is a for-profit public company. No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are currently recorded in the held facts for this company.
